interface.title: Exoplanet Hunter Dashboard (Détection d'exoplanètes)
interface.field: Astronomy / exoplanet detection (Kepler transit photometry, machine learning)
interface.stage_of_work: Model evaluation and vetting of classifier output (after training, before trusting the predictions)
interface.what_it_is_for: Checking a 1D-CNN's planet vs. false-signal verdicts on Kepler Objects of Interest by viewing each signal's score next to its ground truth and folded light curves, and by reading test-set reliability metrics with a decision threshold you can change.

data.note: The app loads precomputed data/results.csv and data/curves.npz when it starts. There are 790 KOIs (400 confirmed planets, 390 false signals), 158 of them in the test split. The cards show test PR-AUC 0.917 and ROC-AUC 0.935. No inference runs in the app. The downloaded results.csv is 48,540 bytes with the columns kepid, kepoi_name, label, period, duration_h, depth, score and split.

tree.specific: Vet the CNN's planet / false-signal calls on Kepler KOIs and judge its reliability on the test set

features.name: Faceted error filter feeding an item picker
features.general: Narrow a list of scored items by true class, data partition and 'only the ones the model got wrong', then pick one item from what is left
features.specific: Sidebar Filtres (Classe réelle: Toutes/Planètes/Faux signaux; Jeu de données: Test/Train/Tous; 'Uniquement les erreurs du modèle') narrows the Signal KOI dropdown
steps: choose a true class (all / planets / false signals)
choose a partition (test / train / all)
tick 'errors only' to keep only misclassified items
open the item dropdown and pick one of the remaining items (the choice goes back to the first item whenever a filter changes)
serves_tasks: List only the misclassified items, split by kind of error
Look at a misclassified item's signal to judge why the model was fooled
Repeat the error search on a different data partition
Compare the predicted label with the known true label

steps: select a KOI
read the gauge percentage against the 50 mark
compare the Vérité terrain and Prédiction badges to see whether the call was right
read period, transit duration and host star
serves_tasks: Pick an item and read the model's confidence next to the underlying signal views
Compare the predicted label with the known true label
Look at a misclassified item's signal to judge why the model was fooled

features.name: Paired global/local signal viewer with zoom, pan and export
features.general: Show the same item's signal at two scales side by side (whole cycle and zoom on the event), with box-zoom, pan, hover readout, reset, full-screen and PNG export
features.specific: 'Vue globale (orbite complète)' and 'Vue locale (zoom sur le transit)' phase-folded light curves (normalised flux vs bins) using the Plotly modebar
steps: select a KOI so both curves redraw
drag a box to zoom into the transit dip
hover a point to read (bin, flux)
switch to Pan and drag, then press Reset axes
open Fullscreen or download the plot as PNG
serves_tasks: Look closely at the signal curves
Pick an item and read the model's confidence next to the underlying signal views
Look at a misclassified item's signal to judge why the model was fooled

features.name: Threshold slider driving a confusion matrix
features.general: Move a decision cut-off on a probability score and watch the 2×2 counts of correct calls, false alarms and misses update
features.specific: 'Seuil de décision' slider (0.05–0.95) above the test-set 'Matrice de confusion' (Réel × Prédit: Faux signal / Planète)
steps: read the matrix at the default 0.50
drag the slider lower to catch more planets (fewer FN, more FP)
drag it higher, or press End, for a stricter cut (fewer FP, more FN)
compare the off-diagonal counts between settings
serves_tasks: Move the decision cut-off and watch the error counts trade off

features.name: Class-separated score histogram with legend isolation
features.general: Overlay histograms of model scores for each true class and hide one class to look at the other alone
features.specific: 'Distribution des scores': overlaid red Faux signaux and green Planètes bars over score 0–1, with clickable legend
steps: read where each class piles up (near 0 vs near 1)
click a legend entry to hide that class
inspect the remaining class's tail (e.g. false signals scored above 0.5)
click again to restore
serves_tasks: Check how well the score separates the two classes
